page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top centre and a catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: tanæ, quæ habitu mundo matronali spoliata, flagrisq; excruciata, non solum intrepide crudelitatis administros reprehendit, dicens: Ministri diaboli, ea quæ ad contumeliam facitis, laudi mihi sunt: sed etiâ unici, nobilissimi, & adhuc tenera ætate filij Maiorici, cruciatuum spectatrix, ei dixit: Memento fili, nos in nomine sacrosanctæ Trinitatis baptizatos: ne igitur pudamus [?] indumentum nostræ salutis, ne veniens inuitator uestem non inueniat nuptialem. Illa pœna timenda est, quæ nunquam finitur. Illud autem in illa historia mirè patheticum est, quòd cum generosæ Matri, optimi Adolescentis, qui in confessionis certamine spiritum Christo tradiderat, corpus traditum esset terræ mandandum, Mater heroica corpus exanime amplexans, Deoq; gratias immortales agens, ad gaudium spei futuræ, in sua domo citra superstitionem maluit sepelire, ut quoties supra sepulcrum eius ad sacrosanctam Trinitatem preces funderet, alienam à filio eiusq; fide & spe, quæ in illo Martyre fulserant, sese neutiquam esse, testaretur.

page.notes: The first word is a fragment carried over from the previous page and stays as printed. The ornament before the catchword is a printer's mark, not text. "pudamus" is printed with a damaged letter after the p, so the reading is doubtful. The running head reads PROOEMIUM in the printed spaced capitals.
